But dogged analysis while the poo was flying thick and fast generated targeted calls and positioning insights that took the portfolio I run for the Pro tier up 2x in 2 months. I don't overtrade. I make high-conviction calls.

My primary calls:

1. Derive ethereum:0xb1d1eae60eea9525032a6dcb4c1ce336a1de71be, up 5x from the March Deep Dive

My lane is crypto. That's what I love, and I have never been more bullish on the secular trend that inspired me to leave the TradFi world years ago.
